summary: TotalYearType is a C# class used for defining and handling lists of year or term-related codes and values throughout the HSPnet application. These lists support workflows for generating selectable options for terms, years, certification expiry, flu seasons, mask fit test dates, graduation status, sections, and report types. Logic is embedded for term calculations, date range computations, and localization through resource strings.
purpose: To provide configurable, localized lists of year, term, and period codes and values for use in dropdowns, data entry, and reporting, with term logic and support for multiple domain workflows (e.g., certifications, flu seasons, graduation, mask fitting).

entities.name: TotalYearType

actors: System for generating lists and term calculations

workflows.name: TotalYearList Generation
steps: Return alternate language list or standard list of TotalYearData options (codes, values).

workflows.name: Term Calculation
steps: Determine termIndex based on today's date.
Winter if Jan 1 - Apr 30; SpringSummer if May 1 - Aug 31; Fall if Sep 1 - Dec 31.

workflows.name: GetDatesByTerm
steps: Set date ranges for Winter, SpringSummer, or Fall.

workflows.name: CertificationExpiryDateList
steps: Return list of TotalYearData for expiry periods (1–5 years, Other_specify).

workflows.name: N95MaskFitTestDateList
steps: Return list of TotalYearData for mask fit test periods (1–2 years, Other_specify).

workflows.name: TermYearList Generation
steps: Generate a list of years from previous year to five years ahead.

business_rules: Session determines language of the dropdown values.
Year and term options are dynamically generated based on current date.
Term calculation is strictly date-based (hard-coded ranges).
All lists are presented as code/value pairs for UI consistency.
validations: Date inputs must be valid and match required format for term calculations.
Codes are consistently string-typed and must be unique within a list.
calculations: CurrentTerm: Date comparison determines term index.
NextTerm: Advances term based on current date range.
GetDatesByTerm: Returns date ranges mapped to term types.
conditions: Term logic switches on date ranges and term codes.
system_behavior: Lists are generated dynamically and localized for dropdowns.
Business logic for term calculations is encapsulated in static methods.
Sections, report types, and graduation options are provided as lists.
exceptions: Invalid dates may cause date parsing errors.
Unrecognized term type integer may result in no date range.
content_gaps: Resource strings (e.g., Resources.NotApplicableVaries, Resources.Today) are referenced but actual text not present.
Some code comments indicate possible future options (e.g., Future_Requests) but not implemented.
No information found on UI integration or external API usage.
